title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Salts Blueberry Pomegranate 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Pomegranate from the Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection by Doozy Vape Co offers a rich and exotic berry pairing. The experience begins with the smooth, earthy sweetness of ripe Blueberries, creating a juicy and rewarding inhale. A wave of ruby-red Pomegranate juice follows closely behind, adding a tart, complex layer that elevates the profile with a mouth-watering finish. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Seriously Pod Fill Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection translates the vibrant flavours of disposable-style profiles into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers everything from juicy fruits to sweet dessert treats. Beyond Blueberry Pomegranate, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the chilled Blue Pear Ice or the creamy Caramel Coffee.
